intro: Oil has made Guyana's economy one of the fastest-growing in the world.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Offshore oil, pumped since 2019, has multiplied the economy's size. Gold, bauxite, sugar and rice are traditional exports.

chapters.title: Forest deal
text: Guyana sells carbon credits for protecting its forests.
